title: Berryessa：北圣何塞的成熟独栋社区、学校与交通优势
title_en: Berryessa: established single-family neighborhoods, schools and transit
intro: 95132 位于 San Jose 东北部，覆盖 Berryessa 一带的多个成熟住宅社区。这里既有传统独栋住宅，也有靠近山麓的住宅区域，买家可以根据通勤、学校边界、房屋面积和预算进行选择。
I-680 以东到山脚主要是 1960 到 1980 年代的成片独立屋，单层和两层都有，地块规整。I-680 以西和 BART 站周边近年建了不少联排和公寓，层数多、车库常为前后纵列式，带 HOA。同样叫 Berryessa，这两类房子的日常使用和持有成本差别很大。

BART 的 Berryessa/North San José 站在 1620 Berryessa Rd，站内有 VTA 公交，停车场由 VTA 管理，先到先得。VTA 轻轨 Orange Line 沿 Capitol Ave 设站，可到 Milpitas 站换乘 BART；轻轨的 Berryessa 站和 BART 站不是同一个地方。开车向北走 I-680 去 Milpitas、Fremont，走 US-101 或 I-880 去 North San Jose 和半岛。日常散步、骑车常走 Penitencia Creek Trail，一路通往 Alum Rock Park。
intro_en: 95132 sits in the northeast corner of San Jose and takes in many of Berryessa’s established neighborhoods. It offers classic single-family homes and foothill-edge streets, so buyers can sort by commute, school boundaries, home size and budget.

East of I-680 toward the hills, most homes are single-family tracts from the 1960s through the 1980s, one or two stories on regular lots. West of I-680 and around the BART station, newer townhomes and condos are taller, often with tandem garages and HOA dues. They share a neighborhood name but live and cost very differently.

The Berryessa/North San José BART station is at 1620 Berryessa Rd, with VTA buses on site and first-come VTA-managed parking. VTA’s Orange Line light rail runs along Capitol Ave and connects to BART at Milpitas; note that the light-rail Berryessa stop is not the BART station. By car, I-680 heads north to Milpitas and Fremont, while US-101 or I-880 reach North San Jose and the Peninsula. Penitencia Creek Trail is the everyday walking and cycling route toward Alum Rock Park.
buyer: 95132 内部的学校划片并不完全相同。需要逐地址核实小学、初中和高中学区。同时，靠近 Berryessa/North San José BART Station 的住宅与靠近山麓的住宅，在交通、环境和房屋特点上存在差异。

学校方面，这一带大部分属于 Berryessa Union School District（TK–8），高中归 East Side Union High School District；靠 US-101 一侧的部分地址属于 Orchard School District。Berryessa Union 自 2025–26 学年起关闭了 Cherrywood、Toyon、Laneview 三所小学，房源描述如果还写着这些学校，以学区查询工具为准。
老独立屋重点看屋顶、管线和窗户更新。站区新联排要逐项核对 HOA、访客停车、楼梯层数，以及税单上有没有 Mello-Roos 之类的特别评估。BART 站本身的地址在 95133，从家到站台的路线要实际走一遍。BART 轨道、I-680 和 US-101 沿线有噪音，看房时留意。靠东山的地块，请在州地质调查局地图上查断层带和滑坡图层，在 CAL FIRE 地图上查火险等级，并提前询问保险。
buyer_en: School assignments are not uniform across 95132. Check elementary, middle and high school districts for each address. Homes near the Berryessa/North San José BART station and homes near the foothills also differ in transit, surroundings and construction.

Most of the area falls in Berryessa Union School District (TK–8), with high schools in East Side Union High School District, while some addresses toward US-101 are in Orchard School District. Berryessa Union closed Cherrywood, Toyon and Laneview elementary schools starting in 2025–26. If a listing still names one, rely on the district lookup.

On older homes, look at the roof, plumbing and windows. On newer townhomes near the station, check HOA dues, guest parking, stairs and any special assessments such as Mello-Roos on the tax bill. The BART station’s own address is in 95133, so walk the real route from the home to the platform. The BART tracks, I-680 and US-101 all bring noise. For lots near the east hills, check the state fault and landslide maps and CAL FIRE hazard maps, and ask about insurance early.
seller: 95132 的独栋房屋不能简单与 95131 的 Townhouse 或 Condo 比较。建议根据同类房型、地块面积、学校边界、装修程度和最近成交记录进行定价。
Berryessa Rd 上的 San Jose Flea Market 用地已在 2021 年 6 月获批改为公交导向的开发，附近住户要预期未来有施工期。挂牌介绍里涉及这类周边变化时，以市政府公开资料为准。
seller_en: A 95132 single-family home should not be priced against 95131 townhomes or condos. Use the same home type, lot size, school boundary, level of finish and recent sales.

The San Jose Flea Market site on Berryessa Rd was approved in June 2021 for transit-oriented development, so nearby residents should expect construction at some point. When a listing touches on changes like this, rely on the city’s published information.
